caption: The drawing depicts a square arrangement composed of a grid of small, colorful illustrations on a beige or off-white background. Each square in the grid contains a different object, most of which are plant-themed or nature-related, such as flowers in various colors (red, yellow, blue, green), baskets with flowers, and small trees or branches. Among the nature motifs, there are also animals, including birds, a dog, and possibly a lamb. A house with a red roof appears in at least two of the squares. In addition, there are other objects such as a blue urn, a flag on a hill, a heart, and a sailing boat. In the center of the grid, the name "IRENE B FORMAN" is written in uppercase letters, with each letter colored red, green, or yellow. Above this name, the year "1853" is situated in one of the squares, also in colored letters. Scattered throughout the design are small red dots at each intersection of the grid lines, which further divide and frame each illustration. The whole composition is set against a background that resembles finely woven fabric or parchment.
title: Bedspread
